statement: To register a company, the memorandum of association must be delivered to the registrar together with an application for registration and a statement of compliance; the application must state the proposed name, where the registered office is to be situated (England and Wales, Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland), whether the liability of the members is to be limited, and if so whether it is to be limited by shares or by guarantee, whether the company is to be private or public, and that the subscribers wish to form the company for lawful purposes.
caveat: Section 9 also requires statements of capital and initial shareholdings, proposed officers, initial significant control, the registered office and registered email addresses, and subscriber disqualification statements added in 2023 and 2015 amendments. Confirm the current Companies House filing requirements before incorporating.
